# =====================================================================
#  lvgl_app — UI 静态库
#
#  组成：
#   - ui.c 装配 + displayfocusmanager/audiofocusmanager 导航与焦点框架
#   - Home 屏 + components/fonts/images + audio_settings
#   - HCN_APP_BT：ui_Bluetooth 屏 + bt_focus_adapter 焦点桥
#   - full 模式：MVVM（emitter + dashboard_model + dashboard_vm）
#                 + dashboard_view（LVGL View，订阅 vm emitter）
#
#  buildroot local site 包把 application/ 整树 rsync 到构建目录；SITE 之外
#  的外部路径经 CACHE 变量注入，默认值仅适配源码树内直接 cmake 的场景。
# =====================================================================

# hcn application 源码根（提供 "MVVM/..." 头前缀与 MVVM 源码）
set(HCN_APP_APPSRC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../src" CACHE PATH
    "hcn application src dir (MVVM), injected by hcn-application.mk for buildroot builds")
# libsettings_atc：audio_settings.c 依赖 AtcAudioSettings.h（ioctl 契约）
set(HCN_APP_SETTINGS_INC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../../../packages/graphics/libsettings_atc/include" CACHE PATH
    "libsettings_atc include dir, injected by hcn-application.mk for buildroot builds")

# audio_settings.c 依赖 AtcAudioSettings.h；该头不在 staging，必须由源码树提供。
# 构建拷贝树里相对默认值不成立，缺注入时在这里直接失败，避免落到编译期才报。
if(NOT EXISTS "${HCN_APP_SETTINGS_INC}/AtcAudioSettings.h")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "AtcAudioSettings.h not found in HCN_APP_SETTINGS_INC=${HCN_APP_SETTINGS_INC}\n"
        "buildroot 构建需在 hcn_application.mk 传 -DHCN_APP_SETTINGS_INC=<source>/packages/graphics/libsettings_atc/include；\n"
        "改过 CONF_OPTS 后必须 reconfigure 或 dirclean，-rebuild 不会重跑 configure。")
endif()

SET(SOURCES
    ui.c

    screens/ui_Home.c
    screens/dvr_view.c
    screens/dvr_page.c

    frameworks/app_common.c
    frameworks/audiofocusmanager.c
    frameworks/audio_settings.c
    frameworks/displayfocusmanager.c
    frameworks/ui_shared_apps.c
    frameworks/ui_variant.c

    components/ui_comp.c
    components/ui_comp_hook.c
    components/ui_comp_appitem.c

    ui_helpers.c

    fonts/ui_font_chinese_16.c

    images/ui_img_carplaysettings_png.c
    images/ui_img_carplayapp_png.c
    images/ui_img_androidautosettings_png.c
    images/ui_img_androidautoapp_png.c
    images/ui_img_video_png.c
    images/ui_img_rvc_car_png.c
    images/ui_img_music_png.c
    images/ui_img_picture_png.c
    images/ui_img_setting_png.c
    images/ui_img_btcall_png.c

    # DVR page images (generated by convert_dvr_images.py)
    images/ui_img_dvr_bg_png.c
    images/ui_img_dvr_list_bg_png.c
    images/ui_img_dvr_icon_png.c
    images/ui_img_dvr_loading_0_png.c
    images/ui_img_dvr_loading_1_png.c
    images/ui_img_dvr_loading_2_png.c
    images/ui_img_dvr_loading_3_png.c
    images/ui_img_dvr_loading_4_png.c
    images/ui_img_dvr_loading_5_png.c
    images/ui_img_dvr_loading_6_png.c
    images/ui_img_dvr_loading_7_png.c
    images/ui_img_dock_bg_png.c
    images/ui_img_dock_selected_png.c
    images/ui_img_line_png.c
    images/ui_img_icon_camera_n_png.c
    images/ui_img_icon_camera_p_png.c
    images/ui_img_icon_playback_n_png.c
    images/ui_img_icon_playback_p_png.c
    images/ui_img_icon_photo_n_png.c
    images/ui_img_icon_photo_p_png.c
    images/ui_img_icon_settings_n_png.c
    images/ui_img_icon_settings_p_png.c
    images/ui_img_icon_view_n_png.c
    images/ui_img_icon_view_p_png.c
    images/ui_img_icon_delete_n_png.c
    images/ui_img_icon_delete_p_png.c
    images/ui_img_list_bg_n_png.c
    images/ui_img_list_bg_p_png.c
    images/ui_img_list_icon_video_n_png.c
    images/ui_img_list_icon_video_p_png.c
    images/ui_img_list_icon_img_n_png.c
    images/ui_img_list_icon_img_p_png.c
    images/ui_img_pop_up_bg_png.c
    images/ui_img_pop_up_btn_n_png.c
    images/ui_img_pop_up_btn_p_png.c
    images/ui_img_settings_btn1_n_png.c
    images/ui_img_settings_btn1_p_png.c
    images/ui_img_settings_btn2_n_png.c
    images/ui_img_settings_btn2_p_png.c
    images/ui_img_settings_btn2w_n_png.c
    images/ui_img_settings_btn2w_p_png.c
    images/ui_img_settings_btn3_n_png.c
    images/ui_img_settings_btn3_p_png.c
    images/ui_img_settings_s_png.c
    images/ui_img_storage_n_png.c
    images/ui_img_storage_p_png.c
    )

# 蓝牙屏 + 焦点桥（HCN_APP_BT 顶层开关，cache 变量在父作用域声明）：
# 适配层本体在 application/adapters/bt，bt include 路径由顶层 CMakeLists
# 统一注入 lvgl_app（ui_Bluetooth.c / bt_focus_adapter.c / ui_Home.c 均引用）
if(HCN_APP_BT)
    list(APPEND SOURCES
        screens/ui_Bluetooth.c
        frameworks/bt_focus_adapter.c)
endif()

# 本地音乐屏 + 音频焦点桥 + 生成的 CJK 字体（HCN_APP_MUSIC 顶层开关，cache 变量在父作用域声明）：
# 适配层本体在 application/adapters/music，include 路径由顶层 CMakeLists 统一注入 lvgl_app
if(HCN_APP_MUSIC)
    list(APPEND SOURCES
        screens/ui_Music.c
        screens/ui_Music_cf.c
        screens/music_art.c
        screens/music_search.c
        screens/music_pinyin.c
        screens/music_pinyin_table.c
        frameworks/music_focus.c
        fonts/music_font_20.c
        fonts/music_font_32.c)
endif()

add_library(lvgl_app STATIC ${SOURCES})

get_filename_component(HCN_APPLICATION_LVGL_PARENT_DIR "${HCN_APPLICATION_LVGL_INC}" DIRECTORY)

target_include_directories(lvgl_app PUBLIC
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/..
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    ${HCN_APPLICATION_LVGL_INC}
    ${HCN_APPLICATION_LVGL_PARENT_DIR}
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/frameworks
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/screens
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/components
    ${HCN_APP_SETTINGS_INC}
    )

if(DEFINED HCN_APP_UI_VARIANT_MODE)
    target_compile_definitions(lvgl_app PRIVATE
        HCN_APP_UI_VARIANT_MODE=${HCN_APP_UI_VARIANT_MODE})
else()
    target_compile_definitions(lvgl_app PRIVATE HCN_APP_UI_VARIANT_MODE=0)
endif()

if(HCN_APP_BT)
    target_compile_definitions(lvgl_app PUBLIC HCN_APP_HAVE_BT)
endif()
if(HCN_APP_CARPLAY)
    target_compile_definitions(lvgl_app PUBLIC LVGL_BUILD_CARPLAY)
endif()

if(HCN_APP_MODE STREQUAL "full")
    # MVVM（UI 无关层）+ LVGL View
    target_sources(lvgl_app PRIVATE
        ${HCN_APP_APPSRC}/MVVM/core/emitter.c
        ${HCN_APP_APPSRC}/MVVM/model/dashboard_model.c
        ${HCN_APP_APPSRC}/MVVM/viewModel/dashboard_vm.c
        screens/dashboard_view.c
        frameworks/dashboard_bridge.c
        )
    # "MVVM/..." 头前缀（application 内 MVVM 源码；vehicle_services 不参与）
    target_include_directories(lvgl_app PUBLIC ${HCN_APP_APPSRC})
    target_include_directories(lvgl_app PUBLIC ${HCN_APPLICATION_VS_INC})
endif()

set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE} -Os")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_MINSIZEREL "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS_MINSIZEREL} -Os")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} -Wl,--gc-sections")

target_link_libraries(lvgl_app
    lvgl
    settings_atc
    pthread
    )

install(TARGETS lvgl_app ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib)

# ---- Template UI variant ------------------------------------------------
set(HCN_UI_TEMPLATE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ui_template")
set(HCN_APP_UI_TEMPLATE_ASSETS "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/share/hcn_application/assets" CACHE PATH
    "Template UI assets directory on target")

if((HCN_APP_UI_VARIANT STREQUAL "auto" OR HCN_APP_UI_VARIANT STREQUAL "template") AND
   EXISTS "${HCN_UI_TEMPLATE_DIR}/ui_template.c")
    if(NOT EXISTS "${HCN_APPLICATION_LVGL_INC}/lvgl.h")
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "lvgl.h not found in HCN_APPLICATION_LVGL_INC=${HCN_APPLICATION_LVGL_INC}\n"
            "buildroot 构建需保证该目录指向 $(STAGING_DIR)/usr/include/lvgl")
    endif()

    file(GLOB_RECURSE HCN_UI_TEMPLATE_SOURCES "${HCN_UI_TEMPLATE_DIR}/*.c")
    list(FILTER HCN_UI_TEMPLATE_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "/port/hcn_application_entry\\.c$")

    add_library(lvgl_ui_template STATIC ${HCN_UI_TEMPLATE_SOURCES})

    target_include_directories(lvgl_ui_template PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/..
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
        ${HCN_APPLICATION_LVGL_INC}
        ${HCN_APPLICATION_LVGL_PARENT_DIR}
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/frameworks
        ${HCN_UI_TEMPLATE_DIR}
        ${HCN_UI_TEMPLATE_DIR}/ui
        ${HCN_UI_TEMPLATE_DIR}/ui/common
        ${HCN_UI_TEMPLATE_DIR}/ui/custom
        ${HCN_UI_TEMPLATE_DIR}/ui/font
        ${HCN_UI_TEMPLATE_DIR}/ui/logic
        ${HCN_UI_TEMPLATE_DIR}/ui/proxy
        ${HCN_UI_TEMPLATE_DIR}/ui/view
        ${HCN_UI_TEMPLATE_DIR}/ui/view/home_view
        ${HCN_UI_TEMPLATE_DIR}/ui/view/setting_view
        ${HCN_UI_TEMPLATE_DIR}/ui/view/phone_view
        ${HCN_UI_TEMPLATE_DIR}/ui/view/ota_view
        ${HCN_UI_TEMPLATE_DIR}/ui/view/radio_view
        ${HCN_UI_TEMPLATE_DIR}/ui/view/dvr_view
        ${HCN_UI_TEMPLATE_DIR}/port
        ${HCN_UI_TEMPLATE_DIR}/platform/include
        ${HCN_UI_TEMPLATE_DIR}/platform/device
        ${HCN_APPLICATION_VS_INC}
        ${HCN_APP_SETTINGS_INC}
        )

    target_compile_definitions(lvgl_ui_template PRIVATE
        LV_CONF_INCLUDE_SIMPLE
        LV_FONT_SOURCE_HAN_SANS_SC_16_CJK=1
        HCN_APP_UI_TEMPLATE_ASSETS="${HCN_APP_UI_TEMPLATE_ASSETS}"
        LVGL_DIR="A:${HCN_APP_UI_TEMPLATE_ASSETS}/"
        dvr_page_create=hcn_ui_template_dvr_page_create
        dvr_view_init=hcn_ui_template_dvr_view_init
        )

    if(HCN_APP_BT)
        target_compile_definitions(lvgl_ui_template PRIVATE HCN_APP_HAVE_BT)
    endif()
    if(HCN_APP_CARPLAY)
        target_compile_definitions(lvgl_ui_template PRIVATE LVGL_BUILD_CARPLAY)
    endif()

    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_options(lvgl_ui_template PRIVATE /utf-8 /FIstring.h)
    else()
        target_compile_options(lvgl_ui_template PRIVATE -include string.h)
    endif()

    target_link_libraries(lvgl_ui_template
        lvgl
        settings_atc
        m
        pthread
        )

    target_compile_definitions(lvgl_app PRIVATE HCN_APP_HAVE_TEMPLATE_UI)
    target_compile_definitions(lvgl_app PRIVATE
        HCN_APP_UI_TEMPLATE_ASSETS="${HCN_APP_UI_TEMPLATE_ASSETS}")

    install(TARGETS lvgl_ui_template ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib)
    install(DIRECTORY "${HCN_UI_TEMPLATE_DIR}/ui/assets/"
            DESTINATION share/hcn_application/assets)
elseif(HCN_APP_UI_VARIANT STREQUAL "template")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "UI variant is template but ${HCN_UI_TEMPLATE_DIR}/ui_template.c is missing")
endif()
